frases: Every black belt was once a white belt who never gave up.
Every check-in is a chapter in your mat story.
Evolution isn't linear — on OssTrack it's visible.
Your best self shows up when no one is watching.

features.subtitulo: A complete platform to turn attendance into evolution.
features.checkinDesc: QR code with geolocation. Your student checks in in seconds.
features.evolucaoDesc: Every class counts. Every degree matters. Progression is clear to everyone.
features.gamificacaoDesc: Streaks, achievements and ranking. Turn discipline into a game.
features.financasDesc: Plans, contracts and automated billing. Less spreadsheet, more Jiu-Jitsu.
features.whatsappDesc: Notifications and billing via WhatsApp. No additional app.
features.graduacaoDesc: Set objective belt criteria. Promote with fairness.

comoFunciona.subtitulo: 3 steps to get your academy online.
comoFunciona.passo1Desc: Register your academy, set graduation rules and you're ready.
comoFunciona.passo2Desc: Each has their own profile, belt and history. Fully synced.
comoFunciona.passo3Desc: Check-ins, streaks, achievements. Data that motivates.
